name: E5 test
description: Test chart for E5 (cut rules), 17 Nov. Capacity falls linearly with boom angle (1.20 kg at 0 deg -> 0.80 at 50 deg), same at every extension, so the 0.950 kg coin box reaches WARN (90 %) near 18 deg and CUT (100 %) near 31 deg, mid-range where the motor has margin. Not a real rating.
